content:
elaine (PM): quick triage request — pulled 3 support tickets asking for streaming completions that emit function/tool call events mid-stream + stronger structured-output guarantees. customers: AcmeHealth, BrightCart, and Glint.ai. can we decide scope and priority?
sam (Support): gist from tickets: AcmeHealth sees our current stream finish with a final `function_call` payload only. they want the function event surfaced as it’s generated (so they can start IO while tokens continue). ticket #6821.
mario (Sales): blocking 2 PoCs. AcmeHealth & BrightCart both said they’ll pause pilots until we can stream function events. revenue risk = $120k ARR. priority: high.
devin (Eng PM): current runtime batches and only emits function_call envelope when we commit the full message because of how we serialize the `role=function` chunk into the last frame. Streaming mid-call requires protocol change + SDK parsing change. rough estimate: 3 sprints to do properly end-to-end if we include backwards-compatible server+SDK changes.
nora (SWE): engineer perspective: smaller incremental path — introduce an opt-in streaming envelope `<<FUNC_EVENT:{...}>>` interleaved in the token stream. SDKs would detect that pattern and fire `onFunctionEvent` callback. Minimizes changes to core runtime. Risks: ugly hack, edge cases with tokenization and latency spikes.
kyra (SDK Eng): can implement parsing in Node/Python SDKs in ~2 weeks once spec is stable. also need a toggle header and feature flag.
elaine (PM): proposal to triage into 3 scoped deliverables: 1) streaming function-event envelope + SDK hooks (beta, opt-in) 2) structured-output contract enforcement (schema validation + early rejection) 3) docs + migration examples + perf SLOs. recommend we push #1 for Q2 beta to unblock sales, #2 for Q3.
devin (Eng PM): acceptance criteria for #1: a) server can emit function events mid-stream without corrupting token stream b) Node+Python SDKs expose `onFunctionEvent` + accurate payload c) e2e perf: 99th pct token latency <= 200ms under typical load d) feature behind header `x-redwood-streaming-functions: beta` and experimental flag. estimate: 5 people-weeks.
mario (Sales): that sounds fine if we can commit to a firm date window. can product mark as "sales-priority" to surface in roadmap?
elaine (PM): yes — will add to backlog with sales-priority tag and link the tickets. next steps: devin to confirm resourcing, nora/kyra to draft spec for the envelope format and SDK callback surface, sam to attach ticket excerpts + example transcripts. can everyone drop short updates here by EOD Thursday? :thumbsup:
sam (Support): attaching short transcript in ticket: "...stream fragments... <<FUNC_JSON:{\"name\":\"get_quote\",\"args\":{\"ticker\":\"ACME\"}}>> ... final payload". will add to ticket.
nora (SWE): starting spec draft. will post RFC link here when ready.
devin (Eng PM): confirming tentative allocation: 2 infra engineers + 1 SDK for sprint planning. will update by EOD.
kyra (SDK Eng): will scope Node + Python PRs after RFC. need to coordinate release notes + migration snippet.
elaine (PM): great — tagging: @sam (Support) @mario (Sales) @devin (Eng PM) @nora (SWE) @kyra (SDK Eng). leaving this thread open for updates.
